additional definitions: bad bunny|Sum of the 'total' property across all records in the 'invoice' collection.
funny cat|Count of unique 'customer_id' records in the 'customer' collection.
period|Default temporal window filtering invoice_date between 2000-01-01 and 2099-12-31.

extra semantic info.customer_annual_revenue_share: For each customer and year, the ratio of that customer's total invoice spend in the given year relative to their total cumulative spend across all recorded years.
extra semantic info.customer_annual_revenue: For each customer and year, the total invoice spend for that customer in that year.
extra semantic info.customer_total_revenue: For each customer, the total invoice spend across all recorded years.
extra semantic info.customer_yearly_market_share: The ratio of a customer's yearly spend relative to total revenue generated by all customers in that same year.
extra semantic info.customer_relative_efficiency: For each customer and year, the ratio of that customer's total invoice spend in the given year relative to their total cumulative spend across all recorded years, expressed as a percentage.
extra semantic info.customer_absolute_revenue: For each customer and year, the total invoice spend for that customer in that year, along with the total invoice spend for all customers in that year, allowing for comparison of individual customer performance against the overall customer base.
extra semantic info.Customer Lifetime Value (LTV): Total cumulative sum of invoice.total attributed to a single customer_id across all time.
extra semantic info.Average Order Value (AOV): The average total amount per purchase, calculated as SUM(invoice.total) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id).
extra semantic info.Sales Rep Performance / Sales Attributio: The total invoice revenue attributed to each employee (support_rep_id) based on the customers they support, allowing for evaluation of individual sales rep performance.
extra semantic info.Artist Total Sales: Total gross revenue generated by an artist, calculated by summing invoice_line.quantity * invoice_line.unit_price for all tracks linked via album to the artist_id.
extra semantic info.Track Popularity: The total quantity of an individual track sold across all invoice_lines.
extra semantic info.Customer Churn Risk / Recency: The elapsed time in days between the current date and a customer's most recent invoice_date.
